title: Build conditional Pipelines dashboard with exact-output review
description: Implement spec 14.0a Pipelines view in the real TORCH Console and shared isolated demo: deliverable rows, current/parallel stages, time/wait party, DAG/detail timeline, pinned input/output and attempt lineage, reciprocal Work links, before/after output review and scoped feedback/approval/rework. Use current-blocker-first mobile layout and protected refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipelines navigation appears only for relevant project definitions or intentional demo fixtures
Feedback and decisions bind exact output/attempt with fresh preview and authority checks
Desktop/mobile browser qualification proves accessible review and preserved drafts
Demo uses the same renderer but makes zero live API writes
